name: Hardening control failed (security lane) + link state change (syslog) on ONE device: hardening drift story capped at SUSPECTED
comment: T2b. The posture family: a benchmark/own-rule verdict against captured config, corroborated by a control-plane transition on the same box — the 'did the same change cause both?' story. Capped 2026-11-11 (P-424934): a failed control has no onset, so two agreeing planes prove both facts, not one cause; allow_root_cause_confirmed=false holds it at suspected.
